# Twitch sub-actions

## Add blocked term

Adds a word or phrase to your channel's blocked list, so messages with it are held back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Term** | The word or phrase to block, like "badword". |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%blockedTermId%` | Twitch's id for the blocked term |

<small>Type id: `twitch.addBlockedTerm`</small>

## Add channel tag

Adds one tag to your stream tags and keeps the ones you already have.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tag** | The tag to add, like "Cozy". |

<small>Type id: `twitch.addTag`</small>

## Add moderator

Makes a viewer a moderator of your channel.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.addModerator`</small>

## Add suspicious status

Marks a viewer as suspicious, so their messages are flagged or limited. Good against ban evaders.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Status** | Active monitoring flags the viewer's messages for your moderators. Restricted keeps their messages away from everyone else. Options: Active Monitoring, Restricted. Starts as: `Active Monitoring`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%suspiciousUser%` | The display name of the marked person |
| `%suspiciousUserId%` | Their Twitch id |
| `%suspiciousStatus%` | The status they now have |
| `%suspiciousStatusResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `twitch.addSuspiciousStatus`</small>

## Add VIP

Makes a viewer a VIP on your channel.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.addVip`</small>

## Approve or deny AutoMod message

Allows or denies a chat message that AutoMod is holding back for review.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Held message id** | The id of the held message. The default %messageId% is the message from the AutoMod trigger. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |
| **Decision** | Allow lets the message appear in chat. Deny throws it away. Options: Allow, Deny. Starts as: `Allow`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.resolveAutomod`</small>

## Ban user

Bans a viewer from your channel for good. They can no longer chat or watch in chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Reason** | Why they are banned, like "Spam". Moderators can see it. Can be empty. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%bannedUser%` | The display name of the person who was banned |
| `%bannedUserName%` | Their login name |
| `%bannedUserId%` | Their Twitch id |
| `%banResult%` | True when the ban worked |

<small>Type id: `twitch.ban`</small>

## Cancel active prediction (refund) (cancelled, prediction.*)

Cancels the running prediction and gives every viewer their channel points back.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%cancelled%` | True when the prediction was cancelled |
| `%prediction.Title%` | The question |

<small>Type id: `twitch.cancelPrediction`</small>

## Cancel raid

Stops a raid that you started but that has not left yet.

<small>Type id: `twitch.cancelRaid`</small>

## Chat mode: emote-only

Turns emote-only chat on or off. In this mode viewers can only post emotes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled** | Tick to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.emoteOnly`</small>

## Chat mode: follower-only

Turns followers-only chat on or off. In this mode only people who follow you can chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled** | Tick to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Followed for at least (minutes)** | How long someone must have followed before chatting, in minutes. 0 means any follower. Up to 129600 (3 months). Only used when turning it on. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.followerMode`</small>

## Chat mode: slow mode

Turns slow mode on or off. In this mode each viewer must wait between messages.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled** | Tick to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Delay (seconds)** | How long each viewer waits between messages, in seconds (3 to 120). Only used when turning it on. Starts as: `30`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.slowMode`</small>

## Chat mode: subscriber-only

Turns subscribers-only chat on or off. In this mode only subscribers can chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled** | Tick to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.subscriberMode`</small>

## Chat mode: unique chat

Turns unique chat on or off. In this mode a viewer cannot post the same message twice in a row.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled** | Tick to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.uniqueChat`</small>

## Clear channel tags

Removes all of your stream tags.

<small>Type id: `twitch.clearTags`</small>

## Clear chat

Wipes all messages from your Twitch chat at once.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clearSuccess%` | True when the chat was cleared |

<small>Type id: `twitch.clearChat`</small>

## Configure rewards

Turns, pauses and resumes many rewards at once, by name or by group. Only rewards that Cuebot created can be changed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable** | Rewards to turn on. Reward names, reward ids or group names, one per line. A group name changes every reward in that group. |
| **Disable** | Rewards to turn off. Reward names, reward ids or group names, one per line. A group name changes every reward in that group. |
| **Pause** | Rewards to pause. Reward names, reward ids or group names, one per line. A group name changes every reward in that group. |
| **Unpause** | Rewards to resume. Reward names, reward ids or group names, one per line. A group name changes every reward in that group. |
| **Disable rewards that are in no group** | Tick to also turn off every reward that is on and has no group and is not listed above. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many listed rewards could not be changed |

<small>Type id: `twitch.configureRewards`</small>

## Create clip

Makes a clip of the last moments of your stream and saves its web links for the next steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Account for stream delay** | Tick if your stream has a delay set on Twitch, so the clip matches what your viewers saw. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clipId%` | Twitch's id for the new clip |
| `%clipUrl%` | The web link to watch the clip |
| `%clipEditUrl%` | The web link to edit the clip |
| `%createClipSuccess%` | True when the clip was made |

<small>Type id: `twitch.createClip`</small>

## Create poll

Starts a poll in your Twitch chat for viewers to vote on.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Question** | The question, like "What game next?". |
| **Choices** | One per line (or separated by \|). The answers viewers can pick, 2 to 5 of them. |
| **Duration (seconds)** | How long the poll runs, in seconds (15 to 1800). Starts as: `60`. |
| **Channel points per extra vote** | How many channel points an extra vote costs. 0 means viewers cannot buy extra votes. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pollId%` | Twitch's id for the poll |
| `%success%` | True when the poll started |

<small>Type id: `twitch.createPoll`</small>

## Create prediction (predictionId, success, prediction.Id)

Starts a prediction where viewers bet channel points on what will happen.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Question** | The question, like "Will I win?". |
| **Outcomes** | One per line (or separated by \|). The possible results viewers can bet on, 2 to 10 of them. |
| **Submission window (seconds)** | How long viewers can place bets, in seconds (30 to 1800). Starts as: `120`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%predictionId%` | Twitch's id for the prediction |
| `%success%` | True when the prediction started |

<small>Type id: `twitch.createPrediction`</small>

## Create reward

Creates a new channel points reward on your channel.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The name of the reward, like "Hydrate". |
| **Cost** | How many channel points it costs (at least 1). Starts as: `100`. |
| **Prompt** | The text viewers see when they open the reward. Can be empty. |
| **User input required** | Tick if the viewer must type a message when they redeem it. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Enabled** | Tick to make the reward available right away. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%createdRewardId%` | Twitch's id for the new reward |

<small>Type id: `twitch.createReward`</small>

## Create stream marker

Puts a marker into your stream at this moment, so you can find the spot later in your video.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Description** | A short note for the marker, like "Epic fail". It can be empty. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%markerId%` | Twitch's id for the marker |
| `%markerPosition%` | How many seconds into the stream the marker is |
| `%streamMarkerDescription%` | The note on the marker |

<small>Type id: `twitch.createMarker`</small>

## Delete chat message

Deletes one message from your Twitch chat, for example one that broke a rule.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message id** | The id of the chat message. The default %messageId% is the message that started the action. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.deleteMessage`</small>

## End active poll

Ends the poll that is running now.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **How** | End and show results: viewers see who won. End and hide results: the poll disappears without showing the results. Options: End and show results, End and hide results. Starts as: `End and show results`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.endPoll`</small>

## Guest Star: assign slot

Puts a Guest Star guest into a slot so they appear on screen.

| --- | --- |

Looks up your Guest Star settings and saves them for the next steps. Guest Star lets guests join your stream.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%guestStarSlotCount%` | How many guest slots there are |
| `%guestStarLayout%` | The layout in use |
| `%guestStarModeratorSendLive%` | True if moderators may send guests live |
| `%guestStarBrowserSourceAudio%` | True if browser source audio is on |

<small>Type id: `twitch.getGuestStarSettings`</small>

## Guest Star: get invites (guestStarInviteCount, guestStarInvite0UserId, ...Status)

Looks up who you invited to Guest Star and saves it for the next steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Session id** | Leave empty to use the Guest Star session that is running now. Most people leave this alone. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%guestStarInviteCount%` | How many invites there are |
| `%guestStarInvites%` | The ids of the invited people, separated by commas |
| `%guestStarInvite0UserId%` | The first invited person's id. Use 1, 2, ... for the next ones |
| `%guestStarInvite0Status%` | Whether they accepted, like INVITED or ACCEPTED |

<small>Type id: `twitch.getGuestStarInvites`</small>

## Guest Star: get session (guestStarSessionId, guestStarGuestCount, guestStarGuest0..)

Looks up the Guest Star session that is running and its guests, and saves them for the next steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%guestStarActive%` | True if a session is running |
| `%guestStarSessionId%` | The session's id |
| `%guestStarGuestCount%` | How many guests are in it |
| `%guestStarGuest0%` | The first guest's display name. Use 1, 2, ... for the next ones |
| `%guestStarGuest0UserName%` | Their login name |
| `%guestStarGuest0Slot%` | Their slot |
| `%guestStarGuest0IsLive%` | True if they are live on stream |

<small>Type id: `twitch.getGuestStarSession`</small>

## Guest Star: move guest to another slot

Moves a Guest Star guest from one slot to another.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **From slot** | The slot the guest is in now, starting at 1. Starts as: `1`. |
| **To slot** | The slot to move them to, starting at 1. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Session id** | Leave empty to use the Guest Star session that is running now. Most people leave this alone. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateGuestStarSlot`</small>

## Guest Star: remove guest from slot

Takes a guest out of their slot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Guest** | Which guest: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Slot** | The slot number, starting at 1. A slot is one guest spot on screen. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Send back to the invite queue** | Tick to put the guest back into the invite queue. Untick to just remove them. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Session id** | Leave empty to use the Guest Star session that is running now. Most people leave this alone. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.deleteGuestStarSlot`</small>

## Guest Star: send invite

Invites a viewer to join your Guest Star session.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Guest** | Who to invite: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Session id** | Leave empty to use the Guest Star session that is running now. Most people leave this alone. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.sendGuestStarInvite`</small>

## Guest Star: update channel settings

Changes your Guest Star settings, like the number of slots and the layout. Anything set to Keep stays as it is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Slots (1 to 6, 0 = keep)** | How many guest slots, from 1 to 6. 0 keeps the current number. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Layout** | How guests are arranged on screen. Keep leaves it as it is. Options: Keep as it is, Tiled, Screen share, Side by side, Stacked. Starts as: `Keep as it is`. |
| **Moderators can send guests live** | Whether moderators may send guests live. Keep leaves it as it is. On or Off changes it. Options: Keep, On, Off. Starts as: `Keep`. |
| **Browser source audio** | Whether the browser source plays guest audio. Keep leaves it as it is. On or Off changes it. Options: Keep, On, Off. Starts as: `Keep`. |
| **Regenerate browser sources (invalidates the old ones)** | Tick to make new browser source links. The old links stop working, so update them in your streaming software. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateGuestStarSettings`</small>

## Guest Star: update slot settings

Changes the sound, picture, live state or volume of one guest slot. Anything set to Keep stays as it is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Slot** | The slot number, starting at 1. A slot is one guest spot on screen. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Audio** | The guest's microphone. Keep leaves it as it is. On or Off changes it. Options: Keep, On, Off. Starts as: `Keep`. |
| **Video** | The guest's camera. Keep leaves it as it is. On or Off changes it. Options: Keep, On, Off. Starts as: `Keep`. |
| **Live** | Whether the guest is shown on your stream. Keep leaves it as it is. On or Off changes it. Options: Keep, On, Off. Starts as: `Keep`. |
| **Volume (0 to 100, -1 = keep)** | The guest's volume from 0 to 100. -1 keeps the current volume. Starts as: `-1`. |
| **Session id** | Leave empty to use the Guest Star session that is running now. Most people leave this alone. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateGuestStarSlotSettings`</small>

## Reply to message

Answers a chat message so it shows as a reply to that message. Great for command answers.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | What to write back. You can use %variables%, like Hi %user%! If it is empty nothing is sent. |
| **Reply to message id** | The id of the message to reply to. The default %messageId% is the message that started the action. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |
| **Send as** | Which account writes it. Default uses your bot account if it is signed in (see the Twitch page), otherwise your own account. Or pick Bot or Broadcaster. Options: Default, Bot, Broadcaster. Starts as: `Default`. |

## Resolve prediction (success, prediction.*, prediction.winningOutcome.*)

Picks the winning result of a prediction and pays out the winners.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |

## Reward group: set enabled state

Turns every reward in a group on or off at once. Only rewards that Cuebot created can be changed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward group** | The group name, like "Sound alerts". You give rewards a group on the Twitch page (Rewards tab). |
| **State** | Enabled shows the rewards. Disabled hides them. Toggle turns them on, unless one is already on, then it turns them off. Options: Enabled, Disabled, Toggle. Starts as: `Enabled`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many rewards could not be changed |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardGroupEnabled`</small>

## Reward group: set paused state

Pauses or resumes every reward in a group at once. Only rewards that Cuebot created can be changed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward group** | The group name, like "Sound alerts". You give rewards a group on the Twitch page (Rewards tab). |
| **State** | Paused pauses the rewards. Unpaused lets viewers redeem them. Toggle pauses them, unless one is already paused, then it resumes them. Options: Paused, Unpaused, Toggle. Starts as: `Paused`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many rewards could not be changed |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardGroupPaused`</small>

## Reward: delete

Deletes a channel points reward for good.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.deleteReward`</small>

## Reward: fulfil or cancel redemption

Marks a redeemed reward as done (fulfil) or turns it down (cancel). Cancel gives the points back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward id** | The id of the reward. The default %rewardId% is the reward that started the action. Starts as: `%rewardId%`. |
| **Redemption id** | The id of this redemption. The default %redemptionId% is the one that started the action. Starts as: `%redemptionId%`. |
| **Status** | Fulfil marks it as done. Cancel refunds the viewer's channel points. Options: Fulfil, Cancel. Starts as: `Fulfil`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateRedemption`</small>

Looks up how often a reward was redeemed, in total and by one viewer, and saves the numbers.

| **For user** | The viewer to count for: a login name like "coolviewer" or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%counter%` | How many times the reward was redeemed |
| `%userCounter%` | How many times that viewer redeemed it |

<small>Type id: `twitch.getRewardCounter`</small>

## Reward: get info (rewardTitle, rewardCost, rewardEnabled, rewardPaused...)

Looks up a channel points reward and saves its title, cost and settings for the next steps.

| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardId%` | Twitch's id for the reward |
| `%rewardTitle%` | The reward's name |
| `%rewardPrompt%` | The description text |
| `%rewardCost%` | The price in channel points |
| `%rewardEnabled%` | True if the reward is on |
| `%rewardPaused%` | True if the reward is paused |
| `%rewardCooldown%` | The wait time in seconds (0 = none) |
| `%rewardMaxPerStream%` | The limit per stream (0 = none) |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardColor`</small>

## Reward: set cost

Changes how many channel points a reward costs.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardCost`</small>

## Reward: set enabled

Turns a channel points reward on or off. A reward that is off is hidden from viewers.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardEnabled`</small>

Sets how long everyone must wait before the reward can be redeemed again.

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardCooldown`</small>

## Reward: set max per stream

Limits how many times a reward can be redeemed in one stream, by everybody together.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |
| **Maximum** | The most redemptions per stream. 0 turns the limit off. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Additive** | Tick to add this number to the current limit instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to lower it. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardMaxPerStream`</small>

Limits how many times each viewer can redeem a reward in one stream.

| **Maximum** | The most redemptions per viewer per stream. 0 turns the limit off. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Additive** | Tick to add this number to the current limit instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to lower it. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardMaxPerUser`</small>

## Reward: set paused

Pauses or resumes a channel points reward. A paused reward is still shown but cannot be redeemed.

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardPaused`</small>

Changes the description text viewers see on a channel points reward.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.setRewardPrompt`</small>

## Reward: set title

Changes the name of a channel points reward.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |

## Reward: update title, prompt and cost

Changes the name, description and price of a reward in one go. Anything you leave empty stays as it is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's name exactly as on Twitch, like "Hydrate", or its id. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed. |
| **Title** | The new name. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **Prompt** | The new description text. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **Cost** | A number. Leave empty to keep the price. What it does depends on the operator below. |
| **Cost operator** | How to use the cost number. Set makes it the new price. Add, Subtract, Multiply and Divide change the current price. The price never goes below 1. Options: Set, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide. Starts as: `Set`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardCost%` | The reward's price after the change |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateReward`</small>

<small>Type id: `twitch.setSubCounter`</small>

## Snooze next ad (snoozeCount, nextAdAt, snooze.success)

Pushes your next automatic ad back a little. Twitch only allows a few snoozes.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%snoozeCount%` | How many snoozes you have left |
| `%nextAdAt%` | When the next ad starts |
| `%snooze.success%` | True when the ad was snoozed |

<small>Type id: `twitch.snoozeAd`</small>

## Start raid

Sends your viewers to another channel (a raid). Twitch starts it after a short countdown.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channel to raid** | The channel to raid: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%startRaidSuccess%` | True when the raid was started |

<small>Type id: `twitch.startRaid`</small>

## Timeout user

Stops a viewer from chatting for a while (a timeout).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Duration (seconds)** | How long the timeout lasts, in seconds. From 1 second up to 14 days (1209600). 600 is ten minutes. Starts as: `600`. |
| **Reason** | Why they are timed out. Can be empty. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timedOutUser%` | The display name of the person who was timed out |
| `%timedOutUserName%` | Their login name |
| `%timedOutUserId%` | Their Twitch id |
| `%timeoutResult%` | True when the timeout worked |

<small>Type id: `twitch.timeout`</small>

## Unban user

Lifts a ban so the viewer can chat again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%unbannedUser%` | The display name of the person who was unbanned |
| `%unbannedUserName%` | Their login name |
| `%unbannedUserId%` | Their Twitch id |
| `%unbanResult%` | True when the unban worked |

<small>Type id: `twitch.unban`</small>

## Unpin chat message

Removes the pin from a pinned chat message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Pinned message id** | The id of the pinned message. Leave empty to unpin the message that is pinned now. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.unpinMessage`</small>

## Update pinned message duration

Changes how much longer a pinned chat message stays pinned.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Pinned message id** | The id of the pinned message. Leave empty to use the message that is pinned now. |
| **Pinned for (seconds, from now)** | How long it stays pinned from now, in seconds (30 to 1800). 0 keeps it pinned until the stream ends. Starts as: `60`. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updatePinnedDuration`</small>

## Update stream info

Changes the title, the category and the tags in one go. Anything you leave empty stays as it is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The new title. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **Category / game** | The new category, like "Just Chatting". Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **Tags** | New tags separated by commas, like "English, Chill". Leave empty to keep the current tags. |

<small>Type id: `twitch.updateStreamInfo`</small>

## Warn user

Sends a warning to a viewer. They must accept it before they can chat again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: a Twitch login name like "coolviewer" (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty to use the person who triggered the action. |
| **Reason** | What you warn them about, like "Please be kind". They see this text. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%warnedUser%` | The display name of the person who was warned |
| `%warnedUserName%` | Their login name |
| `%warnedUserId%` | Their Twitch id |
| `%warnedResult%` | True when the warning was sent |

<small>Type id: `twitch.warn`</small>
